# Maya by Janet Xiu Shi

> Maya is the AI-powered digital twin of Janet Xiu Shi, an Ireland-based AI Evals and Quality Advisor working across strategic AI and cloud, and AI Educator specialising in AI governance, AI quality and evaluation, and cloud strategy.

Janet Xiu Shi brings 20+ years across enterprise operations, procurement, and technology, and lectures in cloud, generative AI, and web application development in Irish higher education and national workforce programmes.

Maya is built with transparency-by-design: AI disclosure at first interaction, optional Opt-in GDPR consent-based logging so users can support quality improvement of Janet's digital solutions, EU (Ireland) log storage, and automatic 90-day deletion. Chat is available without logging.
